title: Protestant / Evangelical Christianity
sub: How the churches are run, paid for and held to account. A record of institutions, money and power, not of anyone's faith.

head: Protestants worldwide
text: Pew counted 801 million in 2011. Its 584 million Pentecostal and charismatic Christians span every tradition, Catholics included, so they are not a subset of that total.
note: Source: Pew Research Center, Global Christianity (2011).

head: In an independent church, there is no bishop.
rows: The founder, or the founder's family
is the only body that can remove him

head: Members, 2006 to 2025
text: 2025 was the 19th year of decline in a row. Source: Lifeway Research, May 2026; the denomination's own Annual Church Profile.

head: How it came out
rows: Houston Chronicle and San Antonio Express-News: about 380 Southern Baptist leaders and volunteers accused of sexual misconduct since 1998, with more than 700 victims.
Independent Guidepost report: Executive Committee staff kept a private list of accused ministers while publicly resisting a registry.
note: Sources: Houston Chronicle, Feb 2019; Guidepost Solutions, 22 May 2022.

head: What followed
rows: Messengers vote for a public database of accused ministers. No name is ever published.
The Executive Committee shelves it, citing legal hurdles.
Survivors launch ProtestantAccountability.org, with more than 2,700 people listed at launch.
note: Sources: Religion News Service, 2024; The Baptist Paper, 2025; Christianity Today, Sept 2026.

head: penalties
text: Six television ministries were asked for financial records. Most declined full disclosure. The inquiry closed with no penalties and no new law.
note: Source: Senate Finance Committee inquiry, via NBC News, Jan 2011.

head: Who can compel an answer
rows: Churches file no Form 990, the annual public return other charities file. State attorneys general have jurisdiction over charitable assets.
Registered church charities file public accounts. Smaller churches in several denominations are excepted from registering until 2031.
note: Sources: IRS Publication 1828; Charity Commission for England and Wales.

head: 30 control techniques, graded
rows: Court judgment, government inquiry, regulatory action or financial filing.
Repeated leadership instruction from the platform, publications or curriculum.
Community enforcement the institution neither mandates nor prevents.
note: The codex examines institutions, money and power. It does not judge anyone's faith.
